title: Fixed FCFE and follow-up statement retrieval routing
points: Stopped FCFE from being treated as an unsupported ticker symbol so FCFE prompts route to financial statement, market data, and note evidence.
Added numeric note retrieval for depreciation, amortization, fixed-asset schedules, and borrowing proceeds or repayments when FCFE inputs require off-face filing detail.
Improved follow-up statement retrieval by reusing recent company scope when the user asks for a figure without repeating the ticker.
